title: Permissions in a training copy: allow reads and reject edits
goal: Specify and test a minimal reader matrix in an own infobase, separate from the Nexus account.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 5; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: A reader can see a request but cannot edit it. How do you distinguish an access denial from invalid minutes? Check permitted reading and try another valid number. A refusal then concerns the operation rather than the input range.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: The worked example uses its own 30/45=75 set. New independent work continues different own 40/25=65 from A5. Do not compare them as one database. Run permission, restoration and upgrade exercises only in a new isolated copy; preserve the original, DT/CFand previous work. Nexus stores the lesson and your note; it does not change external1Croles or data.

sections.title: Roles describe capabilities
paragraphs: An operator creates and reads requests; a consultant configures variants; a developer changes configuration. These are teaching roles, not a complete production policy. Specify object, action and data scope per operation. Full access for everyone hides the symptom rather than solving responsibility boundaries.

The reader opens an existing request but cannot edit it. This differs from an input operator: define the task before granting access. Reading and editing are separate actions. A valid 30-to-31 edit is used so a duration-boundary refusal cannot masquerade as an access denial.

tables.caption: Denying everything does not prove the matrix

sections.title: How to carry out the worked example
paragraphs: Follow the route in your prepared own copy. This is the worked example; the new task below uses different data. Compare each expectation with your actual reread.

Step 1. Save a DT and restore a separate base through module 1. Verify its path and available administration access. Leave real profiles, source roles and source base intact. Expected: Separate base and retained source identified.

Step 2. Add УчебныйАдминистратор A6 for servicing only this copy and УчебныйЧитатель A6. For the reader allow the needed client, Read/View on Клиенты, Услуги and ЗаявкаУслуги; no update/insert/delete. Retain earlier roles. Expected: Reader matrix permits reading without editing.

Step 3. First ensure a teaching NexusA6Admin profile with the administration role, then NexusA6Reader with only the reader role. Respect training-edition limits: this exercise configures no passwords or Windows authentication. Never overwrite existing profiles. Expected: Teaching identities and roles are separated.
Step 4. Close this copy’s administrator session, open as the teaching reader and read an own saved 30-minute request. Record its actual number. Expected: Request read successfully as 30 minutes.

Step 5. If editing is available, try 31 and save; expect denial. If editing is unavailable, record that without bypassing it. Exit the teaching profile, open as administrator and reread the original 30. Expected: Same number/reference and 30 minutes.

sections.title: Visibility is not permission
paragraphs: Hiding a command can improve UI, but denial must apply to the operation. Another list or programmatic route must not bypass the rule. Denying everything is also incorrect. Alongside each denial, test a necessary allowed operation for the same role.

A role is configuration metadata; an infobase user receives one or more roles. Additional roles can grant more access than the new reader role alone. Assign only the reader role to that teaching profile. Preserve a DT and administration access beforehand; do not replace real profiles or roles.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No.1441 also violates the range rule. Establish permitted reading and attempt a valid change such as 40→41, then reread the previous 40. A profile login or an absent button alone does not replace checking the operation.

sections.title: A check has an environment
paragraphs: Training edition limits authentication and simultaneous sessions. It can teach role structure and scenarios but does not establish a complete multi-user security PASS. Execute the matrix in a permitted environment with separate teaching users. Never use real credentials or publish a password to simplify reproduction.

NexusA6Admin/NexusA6Reader belong only to this own copy. They are not Nexus, Yandex, Windows or production authentication accounts. The official training route does not depend on passwords or Windows authentication. With another authorized edition, retain its existing protection and use a separate teaching instance under its rules.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: Use the second worked case to identify the unsafe or unproved condition. Never perform destructive restoration over existing work.
Check an allowed read and persistent state, explicitly recording untested paths.

sections.title: Denial preserves state
paragraphs: An operator may not change schema or delete a catalog. Record state before the attempt, observed denial and state afterwards. Login failure does not prove object permissions: first authenticate as the intended role and execute an allowed workflow. Distinguish environment failure, permission denial and business validation.

The narrow matrix requires an actual read, rejection of a valid edit and an administrator reread of the original 30 minutes. A login failure alone proves none of that. This exercise creates no row-level restriction: the reader may see all documents its object permissions allow. It does not establish multi-user server security.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Only in a separate restored copy of your A5 work check the training reader’s matrix. Identify the actual number of your 40-minute request in the 40/25 pair. The reader should read 40 but not save valid 41; an administrator then rereads 40, previous references and other fields. If the form does not permit editing, record that and do not bypass it. Preserve existing working profiles; mark scenarios unsupported by your edition as unperformed.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.
